caption: The drawing depicts a single bicycle, oriented horizontally and viewed from the side against a plain, light beige background. The bicycle features two large wheels with wooden rims and six wooden spokes each. The frame is constructed from brown-toned materials, appearing to be wood, and has a simple, angular structure connecting the wheels, seat, and handlebars. The seat is rectangular with a slight upward curve at the back and is colored white or very light gray. A thin, black line, possibly representing a chain or belt, connects the gears attached to the pedals and rear wheel. The pedals are simple and extend outward from the crankset, which is positioned just below the seat and in front of the rear wheel. The handlebars are also made of wood, shaped with a slight upward and forward curve, and are connected to the front wheel via a straight fork. There are no visible brakes, reflectors, or other accessories on the bicycle.
title: Bicycle
